subject: Renewal & expansion — PO, billing contact, tax docs
messages:
From: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@finledger.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finledger.com>, billing@finledger.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal for Redwood — PO and billing update for expansion

Sean / Monica,

We're getting ready to finalize our renewal for Redwood. A couple of items we need to wrap up on our side so Finance can issue the PO and process the invoice: 

- We've increased our committed capacity to the new "Standard+" tier (estimated 250k tokens/mo) — please confirm the updated line items and monthly amount.
- Finance would like a single final invoice for the renewal term plus a separate line for the expanded capacity.
- We will issue a new PO (attached draft: FinLedger_PO_789.pdf). Please confirm the exact billing name and remit-to address you need on the PO.
- Can Redwood provide a current W-9 and your preferred billing contact? Our AR team also asked whether Net 60 is supported; our procurement prefers Net 60 if possible.

Sara — procurement will need the PO number + Redwood's invoice instructions to approve. Can you loop in whoever handles billing?

Thanks,
Sara Lowe
Procurement Manager
FinLedger

Attachment: FinLedger_PO_789.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@finledger.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@finledger.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal for Redwood — PO and billing update for expansion

Sara — thanks for the note and the PO draft. Quick responses below and next steps so we can close this week: 

1) Pricing / scope: I attached the updated quote (Quote_FL_2026Q4.xlsx) and an amendment that lists the Standard+ tier and the monthly committed units. The effective renewal date we have is 2026-12-01 — please confirm if that aligns with your procurement cadence.

2) Billing name / remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   Attn: Accounts Receivable
   88 Market St, 5th Floor
   San Francisco, CA 94105
   EIN: 82-3456789

3) Payment terms: We can offer Net 45 for this renewal/expansion. Net 60 would require approval from Finance / VP Sales for the account given the increased committed spend — I can route that ASAP if you want to request Net 60.

4) Tax forms / attachments: I attached our W-9 (Redwood_W9.pdf) and the proposed amendment (Redwood_Amendment_v2.pdf). If those look good, I'll send the amendment through DocuSign and once we have the signed PO + signed amendment we'll generate the final invoice(s).

5) Next steps: 
   - Please confirm acceptance of Net 45 vs request Net 60 (indicate approver).
   - If PO is ready to sign, please send the signed PO back to billing@redwood.ai.
   - Once we have the signed PO + amendment we will issue invoices and provide payment instructions.

Looping in Marissa from Billing to make sure invoices go to the right place. Monica is on copy to coordinate the go-live of the expanded capacity.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Amendment_v2.pdf, Quote_FL_2026Q4.xlsx, Redwood_W9.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@finledger.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@finledger.com>, billing@finledger.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal for Redwood — PO and billing update for expansion

Sara — hi, Monica here from Customer Success. A few operational notes to help with a smooth upgrade: 

- Effective date: once we receive the signed PO and signed amendment we'll schedule the capacity increase for the next maintenance window (typically 48 hours). If you need the change on 2026-12-01 we can meet that target if documents are returned by 2026-11-10.
- Billing contact: Please use "FinLedger Billing <billing@finledger.com>" as the billing email on the PO; we will send invoices to that address.
- Tax/exemption: If FinLedger is claiming any tax-exempt status, please attach the exemption certificate along with the signed PO. Otherwise the W-9 provided by Sean is sufficient for our AR records.
- Test plan: we'll provision the increased capacity behind a canary flag and monitor latency/cost for the first 72 hours; Sean and I will coordinate the rollout notes.

I'll update our internal runbook and create the renewal case with Engineering once we have signed docs.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Shared doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/finledger/renewal-amendment
From: Sara Lowe <sara.lowe@finledger.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finledger.com>, billing@finledger.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal for Redwood — PO and billing update for expansion

Thanks, Sean / Monica — we can accept Net 45. Procurement has signed the PO (attached). We also attached our signed purchase order (Purchase_Order_789_signed.pdf).

Action items we completed: 
- Signed PO attached (Purchase_Order_789_signed.pdf)
- No tax exemption on file; W-9 accepted
- Billing contact on PO set to billing@finledger.com
- Please send the DocuSign link for the amendment so our legal team can sign.

I can scan and email the signed PO now; if you need the original PDF through DocuSign let me know.

Sara Lowe
Procurement Manager
FinLedger

Attachment: Purchase_Order_789_signed.pdf
